name: FA_MC_BOOKS_SUMMARY
description: FA_MC_BOOKS_SUMMARY contains currency and financial information about asset depreciation in each reporting book. It is an MRC sub-table of FA_BOOKS_SUMMARY.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: PERIOD_COUNTER
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation period.

columns.name: FISCAL_YEAR
columns.description: Name of the accounting fiscal year.

columns.name: PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Period number of depreciation period in the fiscal year.

columns.name: CALENDAR_PERIOD_OPEN_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the calendar period.

columns.name: CALENDAR_PERIOD_CLOSE_DATE
columns.description: End date of the calendar period.

columns.name: RESET_ADJUSTED_COST_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether there is an adjustment that requires to recalculate the adjusted cost of the asset.

columns.name: CHANGE_IN_COST
columns.description: Total change in the cost of the asset for the period.

columns.name: CHANGE_IN_ADDITIONS_COST
columns.description: Change in the addition cost of the asset.

columns.name: CHANGE_IN_ADJUSTMENTS_COST
columns.description: Change in the asset cost due to adjustment.

columns.name: CHANGE_IN_RETIREMENTS_COST
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: CHANGE_IN_GROUP_REC_COST
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: CHANGE_IN_CIP_COST
columns.description: Change in the construction-in-process cost of the asset.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Total recorded cost of the asset.

columns.name: CIP_COST
columns.description: Construction-in-Process cost of the asset.

columns.name: SALVAGE_TYPE
columns.description: Salvage type assigned to the asset. It can be either amount, percentage, or sum of member assets.

columns.name: PERCENT_SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: Salvage value percentage for the asset.

columns.name: SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: Salvage value amount for the asset.

columns.name: MEMBER_SALVAGE_VALUE
columns.description: Sum of member assets salvage value.

columns.name: RECOVERABLE_COST
columns.description: Cost minus salvage value, or depreciation ceiling, whichever is lower.

columns.name: DEPRN_LIMIT_TYPE
columns.description: Depreciation limit type assigned to the asset. It can be either amount, percentage, sum of member assets, or none.

columns.name: ALLOWED_DEPRN_LIMIT
columns.description: Depreciation limit percentage for the asset.

columns.name: ALLOWED_DEPRN_LIMIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation limit amount for the asset.

columns.name: MEMBER_DEPRN_LIMIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Sum of depreciation limit as a flat amount, subtracted from cost.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_RECOVERABLE_COST
columns.description: Adjusted recoverable cost with special depreciation limits taken into account.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_COST
columns.description: Depreciable basis of the asset, calculated as recoverable cost for cost basis depreciation methods, and recoverable cost less the accumulated depreciation for net book value basis methods.

columns.name: DEPRECIATE_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the asset is depreciating.

columns.name: DISABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the group asset is enabled or disabled.

columns.name: DATE_PLACED_IN_SERVICE
columns.description: Date when the asset was placed in service.

columns.name: RATE_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR
columns.description: Internal factor used to adjust depreciation rates to depreciate the net book value over the remaining life.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_CAPACITY
columns.description: Remaining production capacity used to depreciate assets that use units of production method.

columns.name: PRODUCTION_CAPACITY
columns.description: Production capacity for assets that use units of production method.

columns.name: UNIT_OF_MEASURE
columns.description: Physical quantity that is used as a standard for measurement.

columns.name: REMAINING_LIFE1
columns.description: Remaining life of the asset calculated as on the conversion date, prorate date or fiscal year start date.

columns.name: REMAINING_LIFE2
columns.description: Remaining life of the asset calculated as on the fiscal year start date.

columns.name: FORMULA_FACTOR
columns.description: Factor used to adjust the depreciation rate for formula-net book value method assets.

columns.name: UNREVALUED_COST
columns.description: Asset cost without regard to any revaluations.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORTIZATION_BASIS
columns.description: Revaluation reserve used in calculating amortization of revaluation reserve. This changes only when the asset is revalued or an amortized adjustment is performed.

columns.name: REVAL_CEILING
columns.description: Upper limit for revaluing asset cost.

columns.name: EOFY_ADJ_COST
columns.description: Adjusted cost at the end of the previous fiscal year.

columns.name: EOFY_FORMULA_FACTOR
columns.description: Formula factor at the end of the previous fiscal year.

columns.name: EOFY_RESERVE
columns.description: Depreciation reserve at the end of the previous fiscal year.

columns.name: EOP_ADJ_COST
columns.description: Adjusted cost at the end of the previous period.

columns.name: EOP_FORMULA_FACTOR
columns.description: Formula factor at the end of the previous period.

columns.name: SHORT_FISCAL_YEAR_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the asset is added in short tax year.

columns.name: GROUP_ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identification number of the group asset.

columns.name: OVER_DEPRECIATE_OPTION
columns.description: Option indicating whether over depreciation is allowed for the group asset depreciation or not.

columns.name: FULLY_RSVD_REVALS_COUNTER
columns.description: Number of times the asset has been revalued as fully reserved.

columns.name: CAPITALIZED_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the asset is a capitalized or construction-in-process asset.

columns.name: FULLY_RESERVED_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the asset is fully reserved.

columns.name: FULLY_RETIRED_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the asset is fully reserved.

columns.name: LIFE_COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether the asset life is completed.

columns.name: TERMINAL_GAIN_LOSS_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accumulated depreciation remaining for the group asset after the last member asset of the group asset is retired.

columns.name: TERMINAL_GAIN_LOSS_FLAG
columns.description: Option indicating whether terminal gain or loss amount needs to be processed by the Calculate Gains and Losses program, when it is running for the last period of the fiscal year.

columns.name: DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Asset depreciation expense amount.

columns.name: YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: Year-to-date depreciation expense.

columns.name: DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Total depreciation expense including the bonus depreciation recognized for the asset.

columns.name: BONUS_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Bonus depreciation expense. Amount included in DEPRN_AMOUNT.

columns.name: BONUS_YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: Bonus year-to-date depreciation expense. Amount included in YTD_DEPRN.

columns.name: BONUS_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Total bonus depreciation taken since the beginning of the asset life. Amount included in DEPRN_RESERVE.

columns.name: BONUS_RATE
columns.description: Bonus rate used to calculate bonus depreciation.

columns.name: LTD_PRODUCTION
columns.description: Life-to-date production for assets that use a units of production method.

columns.name: YTD_PRODUCTION
columns.description: Year-to-date production for a units of production asset.

columns.name: PRODUCTION
columns.description: Current period production for a units of production asset.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORTIZATION
columns.description: Amount of revaluation reserve amortized during this period.

columns.name: REVAL_DEPRN_EXPENSE
columns.description: Portion of depreciation expense generated due to revaluation of the asset cost. Oracle Fusion Assets does not create any journal entries for this amount. It is for reporting only.

columns.name: REVAL_RESERVE
columns.description: Change in the net book value due to revaluation of asset cost and sometimes also revaluation of depreciation reserve for revaluation period. For all other periods, the revaluation reserve amount after depreciation run.

columns.name: YTD_REVAL_DEPRN_EXPENSE
columns.description: Year-to-date depreciation expense due to revaluation. Oracle Fusion Assets does not create any journal entries for this amount. It is for reporting only.

columns.name: DEPRN_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator as to whether the depreciation amount for the period is overridden.

columns.name: SYSTEM_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: System calculated depreciation amount.

columns.name: SYSTEM_BONUS_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: System calculated depreciation amount.

columns.name: YTD_PROCEEDS_OF_SALE
columns.description: Year-to-date proceeds of sale for an asset.

columns.name: LTD_PROCEEDS_OF_SALE
columns.description: Life-to-date proceeds of sale amount for the asset.

columns.name: YTD_COST_OF_REMOVAL
columns.description: Year-to-date cost of removal amount of the asset.

columns.name: LTD_COST_OF_REMOVAL
columns.description: Life-to-date cost of removal amount for the asset.

columns.name: DEPRN_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation expense adjustment amount for the period.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation expense adjustment amount for the period.

columns.name: UNPLANNED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Unplanned depreciation amount of the asset.

columns.name: RESERVE_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation reserve adjustment amount for the asset.

columns.name: CHANGE_IN_EOFY_RESERVE
columns.description: Change in depreciation reserve at the end previous of fiscal year.

columns.name: SWITCH_CODE
columns.description: Current depreciation code for a Polish depreciation basis that is in use for the asset.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID_IN
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction that created the row.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_HEADER_ID_OUT
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction that terminated the row.

columns.name: POLISH_DEPRN_BASIS
columns.description: Depreciation basis amount used for assets with a polish depreciation basis rule.

columns.name: POLISH_ADJ_REC_COST
columns.description: Adjusted recoverable cost used for assets with a polish depreciation basis rule.

columns.name: METHOD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation method.

columns.name: FLAT_RATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the rates for the flat rate depreciation method.

columns.name: BONUS_RULE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation bonus rule.

columns.name: CEILING_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation ceiling.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CAPITAL_ADJUSTMENT
columns.description: Value of capital adjustment after considering impairment transaction.

columns.name: GENERAL_FUND
columns.description: Value of general fund after considering impairment effect.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Impairment loss amount of the asset.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_RESERVE
columns.description: Total impairment loss recognized for the asset.

columns.name: YTD_IMPAIRMENT
columns.description: Year-to-date impairment amount.

columns.name: IMPAIR_LOSS_BALANCE
columns.description: Accumulated impairment expense.

columns.name: REVAL_LOSS_BALANCE
columns.description: Accumulated revaluation loss balance.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORT_BALANCE
columns.description: Accumulated revaluation amortization.

columns.name: ASSET_TYPE
columns.description: The type of asset allowed in the Oracle Fusion Assets. The asset types allowed are Capitalized, Construction-in-Process, Expensed, and Group.

columns.name: BONUS_RESERVE_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Bonus depreciation reserve adjustment amount for the asset.

columns.name: REVAL_RESERVE_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Revaluation reserve adjustment amount for the asset.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_RESERVE_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Impairment reserve adjustment amount for the asset.

columns.name: BONUS_EXPENSE_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Bonus depreciation expense adjustment amount for the period.

columns.name: EXTENDED_DEPRN_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset depreciation is extended.

columns.name: RESERVE_RET_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation reserve adjustment amount for the period.

columns.name: BONUS_RESERVE_RET_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Bonus depreciation reserve adjustment amount for the period.

columns.name: REVAL_RESERVE_RET_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Revaluation reserve adjustment amount for the period.

columns.name: IMP_RESERVE_RET_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Impairment reserve adjustment amount for the period.

columns.name: AMORTIZE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the asset is amortized or not.

columns.name: ACCELERATED_ADJUSTED_COST
columns.description: The base amount on which the accelerated depreciation is calculated.

columns.name: BONUS_ADJUSTED_COST
columns.description: The base amount on which the bonus depreciation is calculated.

columns.name: ACCELERATED_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: The accelerated depreciation amount calculated for the period.

columns.name: ACCELERATED_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: The accelerated depreciation reserve balance for the period.

columns.name: ACCELERATED_YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: The accelerated depreciation YTD balance for the period.

columns.name: ACC_DEPRN_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: The adjustment amount calculated for retroactive adjustments included in the accelerated depreciation for the period.

columns.name: LEASE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the capital or operating lease.

columns.name: LEASE_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Unique lease payment schedule identification number.

columns.name: LEASE_EXPENSE_BASIS
columns.description: Basis used for calculating the periodic lease expense of the asset.

columns.name: LEASE_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR
columns.description: Internal factor used to amortize the lease basis over the remaining lease term of the asset.

columns.name: DEPRN_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR
columns.description: Controls the speed of depreciation of an asset by multiplying this factor by the annual depreciation rate.

columns.name: FULLY_RESERVE_ON_ADD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to fully depreciate an asset when the asset is added.

columns.name: SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the accounting ledger.

columns.name: ANNUITY_INTEREST_RATE
columns.description: Annual interest rate used to calculate annual interest expense.

columns.name: ANNUITY_INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Annuity interest expense amount.

columns.name: YTD_ANNUITY_INTEREST
columns.description: Year-to-date annuity interest expense amount.

columns.name: LTD_ANNUITY_INTEREST
columns.description: Total annuity interest expense amount.
